# casdoor_adapter (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor adapter, the Casbin adapter that stores the policies of permissions and enforcers.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_adapter" "policies" {
  owner       = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name        = "policies"
  table       = "acme_policy"
  use_same_db = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the adapter, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `database` (String) The name of the database.
- `database_type` (String) The database type, e.g. `mysql` or `postgres`.
- `host` (String) The host of the database.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the database.
- `port` (Number) The port of the database.
- `table` (String) The table that stores the policies.
- `type` (String) The type of the adapter.
- `use_same_db` (Boolean) Whether the policies are stored in the database of Casdoor, so that the connection settings below are not needed.
- `user` (String) The user of the database.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the adapter was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the adapter in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_adapter.example <organization>/<name>
```
